claims.author: willcl-ark
claims.harm: removing the sleep increases the rate at which an unauthorized client can guess RPC passwords
claims.quote: This sleep also slows online password guessing, so I'm not sure I agree that it was made redundant

settled_by.quote: I think the DoS vector identified here is cheaper/easier to hit (and more annoying), so I'd be in favour of patching that up as you propose.

notes: willcl-ark noted that removing the sleep increases RPC password guessing rates, but concluded the DoS vector is cheaper to hit and favored patching it as proposed. hodlinator updated the description and moved the PR to draft to consider alternatives.

participants.note: noted sleep slows password guessing, but supported removing it to fix the cheaper DoS vector
